     1→import pptxgen from 'pptxgenjs';

     7→// Photo dimensions in inches
     8→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W = 4.4;
     9→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H = 2.8;
    10→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W = 3.27;   // 8.3 cm
    11→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H = 3.28;   // 8.34 cm

    13→// Sanitize text for use in filenames
    14→function sanitizeForFilename(text: string): string {
    15→  return text
    16→    .trim()
    17→    .substring(0, 60)
    18→    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]/g, '')
    19→    .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    20→    .replace(/_+/g, '_')
    21→    .replace(/^_|_$/g, '')
    22→    || 'Inspecao';
    23→}
    24→
    25→// Helper function to generate a black image with white text
    26→function generateSerialNumberImage(serialNumber: string): string {
    27→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    28→  const width = 400;
    29→  const height = 400;
    30→  canvas.width = width;
    31→  canvas.height = height;
    32→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    33→  
    34→  if (ctx) {
    35→    // Black background
    36→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    37→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    38→    
    39→    // White text
    40→    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    41→    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    42→    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    43→    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    44→    
    45→    // Draw serial number
    46→    const displayText = serialNumber || 'N/A';
    47→    ctx.fillText(displayText, width / 2, height / 2);
    48→  }
    49→  
    50→  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    51→}

    83→
    84→export async function generatePowerPoint(options: PowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
    85→  const { inspection, photos, additionalParts, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
    86→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
    87→  
    88→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
    89→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
    90→  const finalPhotos = translatedData?.photos || photos;
    91→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
    92→  
    93→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
    94→  
    95→  // Set presentation properties
    96→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
    97→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
    98→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
    99→  
   100→  // Generate slides
   101→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   102→  
   103→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   104→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   105→  
   106→  await generatePhotoSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, language);
   107→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, additionalParts, language);
   108→  
   109→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   110→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   111→  }
   112→  
   113→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   114→  
   115→  // Save the file
   116→  const fileName = `Relatorio_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   117→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   118→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   119→}

   124→export async function generateHomePowerPoint(options: HomePowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
   125→  const { inspection, categories, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
   126→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   127→  
   128→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
   129→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
   130→  const finalCategories = translatedData?.categories || categories;
   131→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
   132→  
   133→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
   134→  
   135→  // Set presentation properties
   136→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
   137→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
   138→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
   139→  
   140→  // Generate slides
   141→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   142→  
   143→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   144→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   145→  
   146→  // Generate category slides
   147→  for (const [index, category] of finalCategories.entries()) {
   148→    const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   149→    if (photosWithImages.length > 0) {
   150→      await generateCategorySlides(pptx, category, index + 1, language);
   151→    }
   152→  }
   153→
   154→  // Collect all parts from all categories for the parts table
   155→  const allPhotos: PhotoData[] = [];
   156→  const allAdditionalParts: AdditionalPart[] = [];
   157→  finalCategories.forEach(category => {
   158→    allPhotos.push(...category.photos);
   159→    allAdditionalParts.push(...category.additionalParts);
   160→  });
   161→  
   162→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, allPhotos, allAdditionalParts, language);
   163→  
   164→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   165→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   166→  }
   167→  
   168→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   169→  
   170→  // Save the file
   171→  const fileName = `Relatorio_Home_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   172→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   173→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   174→}

   176→// Helper function to get translated category title and description
   177→function getCategoryTranslation(categoryId: string, language: Language): { title: string; description: string } {
   178→  const titleKey = `category.${categoryId}`;
   179→  const descKey = `category.${categoryId}Desc`;
   180→  
   181→  return {
   182→    title: t(titleKey, language, { defaultValue: categoryId }),
   183→    description: t(descKey, language, { defaultValue: '' }),
   184→  };
   185→}

   187→/**
   188→ * Detect photo orientation and return appropriate PPT dimensions.
   189→ */
   190→async function getPhotoDimensions(photo: PhotoData): Promise<{ w: number; h: number; isPortrait: boolean }> {
   191→  const imgData = photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData;
   192→  if (!imgData) return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   193→  try {
   194→    const info = await getImageInfo(imgData);
   195→    return info.isPortrait
   196→      ? { w: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W, h: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H, isPortrait: true }
   197→      : { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   198→  } catch {
   199→    return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   200→  }
   201→}
   202→
   203→/**
   204→ * Calculate x,y positions for 1 or 2 photos on a slide,
   205→ * centering them horizontally.
   206→ */
   207→function layoutPhotos(
   208→  dims1: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   209→  dims2: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   210→  y: number,
   211→  gap: number
   212→): Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> {
   213→  const result: Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> = [null, null];
   214→  
   215→  if (!dims1 && !dims2) return result;
   216→  
   217→  if (dims1 && !dims2) {
   218→    // Single photo: center it
   219→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims1.w) / 2, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   220→    return result;
   221→  }
   222→  
   223→  if (dims1 && dims2) {
   224→    // Two photos: center them together
   225→    const totalW = dims1.w + gap + dims2.w;
   226→    const startX = (10 - totalW) / 2;
   227→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: startX, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   228→    result[1] = { photo: null!, x: startX + dims1.w + gap, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   229→    return result;
   230→  }
   231→  
   232→  // Only dims2 (shouldn't happen)
   233→  result[1] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims2.w) / 2, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   234→  return result;
   235→}
   236→
   237→async function generateCategorySlides(
   238→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   239→  category: PhotoCategory, 
   240→  categoryNumber: number,
   241→  language: Language
   242→) {
   243→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   244→  const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   245→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   246→  
   247→  // Get translated title
   248→  const { title: translatedTitle } = getCategoryTranslation(category.id, language);
   249→  
   250→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   251→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   252→    
   253→    // Header with category number (use translated title, no line break)
   254→    addCategoryHeader(slide, `${categoryNumber}. ${translatedTitle.toUpperCase()}`);
   255→    
   256→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   257→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   258→    
   259→    // Detect orientation for each photo
   260→    const dims1 = photo1 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo1) : null;
   261→    const dims2 = photo2 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo2) : null;
   262→    const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, 1.7, 0.2);
   263→    
   264→    // Photo 1
   265→    if (photo1?.imageData && positions[0]) {
   266→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, positions[0].x, positions[0].y, positions[0].w, positions[0].h, language, String(i * 2 + 1));
   267→    }
   268→    
   269→    // Photo 2
   270→    if (photo2?.imageData && positions[1]) {
   271→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language, String(i * 2 + 2));
   272→    }
   273→    
   274→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   275→  }
   276→}

   453→async function generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx: pptxgen, inspection: InspectionData, language: Language) {
   454→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   455→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   456→  addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'MACHINE IDENTIFICATION' : 'IDENTIFICAÇÃO DA MÁQUINA');
   457→  
   458→  // Title
   459→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Machine Identification' : 'Identificação da Máquina', {
   460→    x: 0.3,
   461→    y: 1.1,
   462→    w: 9.4,
   463→    h: 0.4,
   464→    fontSize: 16,
   465→    bold: true,
   466→    color: '000000',
   467→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   468→    align: 'center',
   469→  });
   470→  
   471→  // Photo positions (4 columns) - centered on slide
   472→  const photoWidth = 2.1;
   473→  const photoHeight = 2.1;
   474→  const gap = 0.3;
   475→  const totalWidth = (photoWidth * 4) + (gap * 3);
   476→  const startX = (10 - totalWidth) / 2; // Center the photo group
   477→  const photoY = 1.7;
   478→  
   479→  // Photo 1: Equipamento
   480→  const photo1X = startX;
   481→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   482→    x: photo1X,
   483→    y: photoY,
   484→    w: photoWidth,
   485→    h: photoHeight,
   486→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   487→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },
   488→  });
   489→  
   490→  if (inspection.machinePhoto) {
   491→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(inspection.machinePhoto, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: photoHeight });
   492→    slide.addImage({
   493→      data: processed,
   494→      x: photo1X,
   495→      y: photoY,
   496→      w: photoWidth,
   497→      h: photoHeight,
   498→    });
   499→  } else {
   500→    // Placeholder with camera icon
   501→    slide.addText('📷', {
   502→      x: photo1X,
   503→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 - 0.4,
   504→      w: photoWidth,
   505→      h: 0.5,
   506→      fontSize: 24,
   507→      color: 'CCCCCC',
   508→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   509→      align: 'center',
   510→    });
   511→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Equipment Photo' : 'Foto do Equipamento', {
   512→      x: photo1X,
   513→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 + 0.1,
   514→      w: photoWidth,
   515→      h: 0.35,
   516→      fontSize: 8,
   517→      color: '999999',
   518→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   519→      align: 'center',
   520→      italic: true,
   521→    });
   522→  }
   523→  
   524→  // Label 1: TAG
   525→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   526→    x: photo1X,
   527→    y: photoY + photoHeight,
   528→    w: photoWidth,
   529→    h: 0.4,
   530→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   531→  });
   532→  slide.addText(inspection.tag || (isTranslated ? 'Equipment TAG' : 'TAG do Equipamento'), {
   533→    x: photo1X,
   534→    y: photoY + photoHeight + 0.03,
   535→    w: photoWidth,
   536→    h: 0.35,
   537→    fontSize: 9,
   538→    bold: true,
   539→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   540→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   541→    align: 'center',
   542→  });
   543→  
   544→  // Photo 2: Horímetro
   545→  const photo2X = startX + photoWidth + gap;
   546→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   547→    x: photo2X,
   548→    y: photoY,
   549→    w: photoWidth,
   550→    h: photoHeight,
   551→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   552→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },

   555→  if (inspection.horimetroPhoto) {

   557→    slide.addImage({

   560→      y: photoY,
   561→      w: photoWidth,
   562→      h: photoHeight,
   563→    });
   564→  } else {
   565→    // Placeholder with camera icon
   566→    slide.addText('📷', {
   567→      x: photo2X,
   568→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 - 0.4,
   569→      w: photoWidth,
   570→      h: 0.5,
   571→      fontSize: 24,
   572→      color: 'CCCCCC',
   573→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   574→      align: 'center',
   575→    });
   576→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Hour Meter Photo' : 'Foto do Horímetro', {
   577→      x: photo2X,
   578→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 + 0.1,
   579→      w: photoWidth,
   580→      h: 0.35,
   581→      fontSize: 8,
   582→      color: '999999',
   583→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   584→      align: 'center',
   585→      italic: true,
   586→    });
   587→  }
   588→  
   589→  // Label 2: Horímetro
   590→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   591→    x: photo2X,
   592→    y: photoY + photoHeight,
   593→    w: photoWidth,
   594→    h: 0.4,
   595→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   596→  });
   597→  slide.addText(`${isTranslated ? 'Hour Meter' : 'Horímetro'}: ${inspection.horimetro || '-'}`, {
   598→    x: photo2X,
   599→    y: photoY + photoHeight + 0.03,
   600→    w: photoWidth,
   601→    h: 0.35,
   602→    fontSize: 9,
   603→    bold: true,
   604→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   605→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   606→    align: 'center',
   607→  });
   608→  
   609→  // Photo 3: Serial Number
   610→  const photo3X = startX + (photoWidth + gap) * 2;
   611→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   612→    x: photo3X,
   613→    y: photoY,
   614→    w: photoWidth,
   615→    h: photoHeight,
   616→    fill: { color: inspection.serialPhoto ? 'F5F5F5' : '000000' },
   617→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: inspection.serialPhoto ? 'dash' : 'solid' },
   618→  });
   619→  
   620→  if (inspection.serialPhoto) {
   621→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(inspection.serialPhoto, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: photoHeight });
   622→    slide.addImage({
   623→      data: processed,
   624→      x: photo3X,
   625→      y: photoY,
   626→      w: photoWidth,
   627→      h: photoHeight,
   628→    });
   629→  } else {
   630→    // Black background with white serial number text
   631→    const serialNumber = inspection.sn || '-';
   632→    slide.addText(serialNumber, {
   633→      x: photo3X,
   634→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 - 0.25,
   635→      w: photoWidth,
   636→      h: 0.5,
   637→      fontSize: 18,
   638→      bold: true,
   639→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   640→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   641→      align: 'center',
   642→    });
   643→  }
   644→  
   645→  // Label 3: Serial Number
   646→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   647→    x: photo3X,
   648→    y: photoY + photoHeight,
   649→    w: photoWidth,
   650→    h: 0.4,
   651→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   652→  });
   653→  slide.addText(`${isTranslated ? 'SN' : 'NS'}: ${inspection.sn || '-'}`, {
   654→    x: photo3X,
   655→    y: photoY + photoHeight + 0.03,
   656→    w: photoWidth,
   657→    h: 0.35,
   658→    fontSize: 9,
   659→    bold: true,
   660→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   661→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   662→    align: 'center',
   663→  });
   664→  
   665→  // Photo 4: Local
   666→  const photo4X = startX + (photoWidth + gap) * 3;
   667→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   668→    x: photo4X,
   669→    y: photoY,
   670→    w: photoWidth,
   671→    h: photoHeight,
   672→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   673→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },
   674→  });
   675→  
   676→  if (inspection.localPhoto) {
   677→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(inspection.localPhoto, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: photoHeight });
   678→    slide.addImage({
   679→      data: processed,
   680→      x: photo4X,
   681→      y: photoY,
   682→      w: photoWidth,
   683→      h: photoHeight,
   684→    });
   685→  } else {
   686→    // Placeholder with camera icon
   687→    slide.addText('📷', {
   688→      x: photo4X,
   689→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 - 0.4,
   690→      w: photoWidth,
   691→      h: 0.5,
   692→      fontSize: 24,
   693→      color: 'CCCCCC',
   694→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   695→      align: 'center',
   696→    });
   697→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Location Photo' : 'Foto do Local', {
   698→      x: photo4X,
   699→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 + 0.1,
   700→      w: photoWidth,
   701→      h: 0.35,
   702→      fontSize: 8,
   703→      color: '999999',
   704→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   705→      align: 'center',
   706→      italic: true,
   707→    });
   708→  }
   709→  
   710→  // Label 4: Local
   711→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   712→    x: photo4X,
   713→    y: photoY + photoHeight,
   714→    w: photoWidth,
   715→    h: 0.4,
   716→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   717→  });
   718→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Location' : 'Local', {
   719→    x: photo4X,
   720→    y: photoY + photoHeight + 0.03,
   721→    w: photoWidth,
   722→    h: 0.35,
   723→    fontSize: 9,
   724→    bold: true,
   725→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   726→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   727→    align: 'center',

   731→}
   732→
   733→async function generatePhotoSlides(pptx: pptxgen, photos: PhotoData[], language: Language) {
   734→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   735→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   736→  const slideCount = Math.ceil(photosWithImages.length / 2);
   737→  
   738→  for (let i = 0; i < slideCount; i++) {
   739→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   740→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PHOTOS' : 'FOTOS');
   741→    
   742→    const photo1 = photosWithImages[i * 2];
   743→    const photo2 = photosWithImages[i * 2 + 1];
   744→    
   745→    // Detect orientation for each photo
   746→    const dims1 = photo1 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo1) : null;
   747→    const dims2 = photo2 ? await getPhotoDimensions(photo2) : null;
   748→    const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, 1.6, 0.2);
   749→    
   750→    // Photo 1
   751→    if (photo1?.imageData && positions[0]) {
   752→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo1, positions[0].x, positions[0].y, positions[0].w, positions[0].h, language, String(i * 2 + 1));
   753→    }
   754→    
   755→    // Photo 2
   756→    if (photo2?.imageData && positions[1]) {
   757→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo2, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language, String(i * 2 + 2));
   758→    }
   759→    
   760→    addStandardFooter(slide);
   761→  }
   762→}
   763→
   764→async function addPhotoToSlide(
   765→  slide: pptxgen.Slide, 
   766→  photo: PhotoData, 
   767→  x: number, 
   768→  y: number, 
   769→  w: number, 
   770→  h: number,
   771→  language: Language,
   772→  photoRef: string
   773→) {
   774→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   775→  
   776→  // Check if we have a secondary photo (two photos side by side)
   777→  const hasSecondaryPhoto = photo.secondaryImageData && photo.imageData;
   778→  
   779→  // Calculate photo widths
   780→  const photoWidth = hasSecondaryPhoto ? (w - 0.1) / 2 : w;
   781→  
   782→  // Photo info overlay (if PN exists)
   783→  if (photo.pn) {
   784→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   785→      x: x,
   786→      y: y - 0.4,
   787→      w: w,
   788→      h: 0.35,
   789→      fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 70 },
   790→    });
   791→    
   792→    let infoText = `${isTranslated ? 'Part Number:' : 'Numero da Peça:'} ${photo.pn}`;
   793→    if (photo.partName) infoText += ` ${photo.partName}`;
   794→    if (photo.quantity) infoText += ` ${isTranslated ? 'Qty:' : 'Qtd:'} ${photo.quantity}`;
   795→    
   796→    slide.addText(infoText, {
   797→      x: x + 0.1,
   798→      y: y - 0.35,
   799→      w: w - 0.2,
   800→      h: 0.25,
   801→      fontSize: 9,
   802→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   803→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   804→    });
   805→  }
   806→  
   807→  // Primary Photo
   808→  if (photo.imageData) {
   809→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: h });
   810→    slide.addImage({
   811→      data: processed || '',
   812→      x: x,
   813→      y: y,
   814→      w: photoWidth,
   815→      h: h,
   816→    });
   817→  }
   818→  
   819→  // Secondary Photo (lado a lado)
   820→  if (photo.secondaryImageData) {
   821→    const secondX = hasSecondaryPhoto ? x + photoWidth + 0.1 : x;
   822→    const secondW = hasSecondaryPhoto ? photoWidth : w;
   823→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.secondaryImageData, { targetW: secondW, targetH: h });
   824→    slide.addImage({
   825→      data: processed,
   826→      x: secondX,
   827→      y: y,
   828→      w: secondW,
   829→      h: h,
   830→    });
   831→  }
   832→  
   833→  // Photo reference badge
   834→  const refLabel = isTranslated ? `Photo ${photoRef}` : `Foto ${photoRef}`;
   835→  slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   836→    x: x + 0.08,
   837→    y: y + h - 0.38,
   838→    w: 0.7,
   839→    h: 0.3,
   840→    fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 40 },
   841→    rectRadius: 0.04,
   842→  });
   843→  slide.addText(refLabel, {
   844→    x: x + 0.08,
   845→    y: y + h - 0.38,
   846→    w: 0.7,
   847→    h: 0.3,
   848→    fontSize: 8,
   849→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   850→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   851→    bold: true,
   852→    align: 'center',
   853→    valign: 'middle',
   854→  });
   855→
   856→  // Description
   857→  if (photo.description) {
   858→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   859→      x: x,
   860→      y: y + h,
   861→      w: w,
   862→      h: 0.6,
   863→      fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   864→    });
   865→    
   866→    slide.addText(photo.description.substring(0, 150), {
   867→      x: x + 0.1,
   868→      y: y + h + 0.05,
   869→      w: w - 0.2,
   870→      h: 0.5,
   871→      fontSize: 8,
   872→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   873→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   874→    });
   875→  }
   876→}
   877→
   878→// Interface for hierarchical parts structure
   879→interface PartRow {
   880→  pn: string;
   881→  serialNumber: string;
   882→  partName: string;
   883→  quantity: string;
   884→  isSubPart: boolean;
   885→  parentPn?: string;
   886→  indent: number;
   887→  photoRef?: string;
   888→}
   889→
   890→function generatePartsTableSlides(
   891→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   892→  photos: PhotoData[], 
   893→  additionalParts: AdditionalPart[],
   894→  language: Language
   895→) {
   896→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   897→  // Build photo ref map (same numbering as generatePhotoSlides)
   898→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   899→  const photoRefMap = new Map<string, string>();
   900→  photosWithImages.forEach((p, idx) => {
   901→    photoRefMap.set(p.pn, String(idx + 1));
   902→  });
   903→
   904→  // Build hierarchical parts structure
   905→  const partRows: PartRow[] = [];
   906→  
   907→  // Process each main part and its sub-parts
   908→  photos
   909→    .filter(p => p.pn)
   910→    .forEach(photo => {
   911→      // Add main part
   912→      partRows.push({
   913→        pn: photo.pn,
   914→        serialNumber: photo.serialNumber || '',
   915→        partName: photo.partName || '-',
   916→        quantity: photo.quantity || '-',
   917→        isSubPart: false,
   918→        indent: 0,
   919→        photoRef: photoRefMap.get(photo.pn),
   920→      });
   921→      
   922→      // Find and add all sub-parts for this main part
   923→      const subParts = additionalParts.filter(ap => ap.parentPn === photo.pn);
   924→      subParts.forEach(subPart => {
   925→        partRows.push({
   926→          pn: subPart.pn,
   927→          serialNumber: subPart.serialNumber || '',
   928→          partName: subPart.partName,
   929→          quantity: subPart.quantity,
   930→          isSubPart: true,
   931→          parentPn: photo.pn,
   932→          indent: 1,
   933→          photoRef: photoRefMap.get(photo.pn),
   934→        });
   935→      });
   936→    });
   937→  
   938→  // Add any orphan additional parts (without a parent in the current photos)
   939→  const parentPns = new Set(photos.filter(p => p.pn).map(p => p.pn));
   940→  additionalParts
   941→    .filter(ap => !parentPns.has(ap.parentPn))
   942→    .forEach(orphanPart => {
   943→      partRows.push({
   944→        pn: orphanPart.pn,
   945→        serialNumber: orphanPart.serialNumber || '',
   946→        partName: orphanPart.partName,
   947→        quantity: orphanPart.quantity,
   948→        isSubPart: false,
   949→        parentPn: orphanPart.parentPn,
   950→        indent: 0,
   951→      });
   952→    });
   953→  
   954→  if (partRows.length === 0) return;
   955→  
   956→  // Calculate slides needed (8 rows per slide - peças principais + sub-peças)
   957→  const rowsPerSlide = 8;
   958→  const slidesNeeded = Math.ceil(partRows.length / rowsPerSlide);
   959→  
   960→  for (let slideIndex = 0; slideIndex < slidesNeeded; slideIndex++) {
   961→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   962→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PARTS TABLE' : 'TABELA DE PEÇAS');
   963→    
   964→    // Table title with page indicator if multiple slides
   965→    const titleText = slidesNeeded > 1 
   966→      ? `${isTranslated ? 'Parts Table' : 'Tabela de Peças'} (${slideIndex + 1}/${slidesNeeded})`
   967→      : (isTranslated ? 'Parts Table (Part Number)' : 'Tabela de Peças (Numero da Peça)');
   968→    
   969→    slide.addText(titleText, {
   970→      x: 0.5,
   971→      y: 1.2,
   972→      w: 8,
   973→      h: 0.4,
   974→      fontSize: 14,
   975→      bold: true,
   976→      color: '000000',
   977→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   978→    });
   979→    
   980→    // Table header
   981→    const headerY = 1.7;
   982→    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   983→      x: 0.5,
   984→      y: headerY,
   985→      w: 9,
   986→      h: 0.4,
   987→      fill: { color: '000000' },
   988→    });
   989→    
   990→    const headers = [
   991→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Ref' : 'Ref', x: 0.5, w: 0.6 },
   992→      { text: isTranslated ? 'PN (Serial)' : 'PN (Serial)', x: 1.1, w: 2.2 },
   993→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Part Name' : 'Nome da Peça', x: 3.3, w: 2.6 },
   994→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Qty' : 'Qtd', x: 5.9, w: 1 },
   995→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Type' : 'Tipo', x: 6.9, w: 2.6 },
   996→    ];
   997→    
   998→    headers.forEach(header => {
   999→      slide.addText(header.text, {
  1000→        x: header.x,
  1001→        y: headerY + 0.05,
  1002→        w: header.w,
  1003→        h: 0.3,
  1004→        fontSize: 10,
  1005→        bold: true,
  1006→        color: 'FFFFFF',
  1007→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1008→        align: 'center',
  1009→      });
  1010→    });
  1011→    
  1012→    // Table rows
  1013→    const startIdx = slideIndex * rowsPerSlide;
  1014→    const endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + rowsPerSlide, partRows.length);
  1015→    const slideParts = partRows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);
  1016→    
  1017→    let rowY = headerY + 0.4;
  1018→    const rowHeight = 0.35;
  1019→    
  1020→    slideParts.forEach((part, idx) => {
  1021→      // Row background - different colors for main and sub-parts
  1022→      const bgColor = part.isSubPart ? 'FFF5E6' : (idx % 2 === 0 ? 'F8F9FA' : 'FFFFFF');
  1023→      slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
  1024→        x: 0.5,
  1025→        y: rowY,
  1026→        w: 9,
  1027→        h: rowHeight,
  1028→        fill: { color: bgColor },
  1029→        line: part.isSubPart ? { color: 'FFE0B2', width: 0.5 } : undefined,
  1030→      });
  1031→      
  1032→      // Ref column (Foto X)
  1033→      const refText = part.photoRef 
  1034→        ? (isTranslated ? `Photo ${part.photoRef}` : `Foto ${part.photoRef}`)
  1035→        : '-';
  1036→      slide.addText(refText, {
  1037→        x: 0.5,
  1038→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1039→        w: 0.6,
  1040→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1041→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1042→        color: part.photoRef ? 'FF6600' : '999999',
  1043→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1044→        align: 'center',
  1045→        valign: 'middle',
  1046→        bold: !!part.photoRef,
  1047→      });
  1048→
  1049→      // Sub-part indicator (arrow or dash)
  1050→      if (part.isSubPart) {
  1051→        slide.addText('└─', {
  1052→          x: 1.1,
  1053→          y: rowY + 0.05,
  1054→          w: 0.3,
  1055→          h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1056→          fontSize: 9,
  1057→          color: 'FF6600',
  1058→          fontFace: 'Arial',
  1059→          align: 'center',
  1060→          valign: 'middle',
  1061→        });
  1062→      }
  1063→      
  1064→      // Part Number with Serial (with indent for sub-parts)
  1065→      const pnX = part.isSubPart ? 1.35 : 1.1;
  1066→      const pnText = part.serialNumber 
  1067→        ? `${part.pn} (${part.serialNumber})`
  1068→        : part.pn;
  1069→      slide.addText(pnText, {
  1070→        x: pnX,
  1071→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1072→        w: part.isSubPart ? 1.95 : 2.2,
  1073→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1074→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1075→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'CC5200' : '000000',
  1076→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1077→        align: 'center',
  1078→        valign: 'middle',
  1079→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1080→      });
  1081→      
  1082→      // Part Name
  1083→      slide.addText(part.partName, {
  1084→        x: 3.3,
  1085→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1086→        w: 2.6,
  1087→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1088→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1089→        color: part.isSubPart ? '666666' : '000000',
  1090→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1091→        align: 'center',
  1092→        valign: 'middle',
  1093→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1094→      });
  1095→      
  1096→      // Quantity
  1097→      slide.addText(part.quantity, {
  1098→        x: 5.9,
  1099→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1100→        w: 1,
  1101→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1102→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1103→        color: '000000',
  1104→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1105→        align: 'center',
  1106→        valign: 'middle',
  1107→      });
  1108→      
  1109→      // Type column
  1110→      const typeText = part.isSubPart 
  1111→        ? (isTranslated ? '↳ Sub-part' : '↳ Sub-peça')
  1112→        : (isTranslated ? 'Main' : 'Principal');
  1113→      
  1114→      slide.addText(typeText, {
  1115→        x: 6.9,
  1116→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1117→        w: 2.6,
  1118→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1119→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1120→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'FF6600' : '000000',
  1121→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1122→        align: 'center',
  1123→        valign: 'middle',
  1124→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1125→      });
  1126→      
  1127→      rowY += rowHeight;
  1128→    });
  1129→    
  1130→    addStandardFooter(slide);
  1131→  }
  1132→}
  1133→
  1134→function generateConclusionSlide(pptx: pptxgen, conclusion: string, language: Language) {
  1135→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
  1136→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
  1137→  addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'CONCLUSION' : 'CONCLUSÃO');
  1138→  
  1139→  // Title
  1140→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Conclusion' : 'Conclusão', {
  1141→    x: 0.5,
  1142→    y: 1.2,
  1143→    w: 8,
  1144→    h: 0.4,
  1145→    fontSize: 14,
  1146→    bold: true,
  1147→    color: '000000',
  1148→    fontFace: 'Arial',
  1149→  });
  1150→  
  1151→  // Conclusion text
  1152→  slide.addText(conclusion, {
  1153→    x: 0.5,
  1154→    y: 1.8,
  1155→    w: 9,
  1156→    h: 4,
  1157→    fontSize: 10,
  1158→    color: '000000',
  1159→    fontFace: 'Arial',
  1160→    valign: 'top',
  1161→  });
  1162→  
  1163→  addStandardFooter(slide);
  1164→}

  1166→function generateFinalSlide(pptx: pptxgen, language: Language = 'pt', reportId?: string) {
  1167→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
  1168→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
  1169→  
  1170→  // Separator line
  1171→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
  1172→    x: 4.5,
  1173→    y: 0.8,
  1174→    w: 1,
  1175→    h: 0.08,
  1176→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
  1177→  });
  1178→  
  1179→  // Logo
  1180→  slide.addImage({
  1181→    data: LOGO_BASE64,
  1182→    x: 3.5,
  1183→    y: 1.1,
  1184→    w: 3,
  1185→    h: 1.7,
  1186→    sizing: { type: 'contain' },
  1187→  });
  1188→  
  1189→  // Safety quote
  1190→  slide.addText('"If it\'s not safe, don\'t do it!"', {
  1191→    x: 1,
  1192→    y: 3.0,
  1193→    w: 8,
  1194→    h: 0.8,
  1195→    fontSize: 28,
  1196→    bold: true,
  1197→    color: 'FF6600',
  1198→    fontFace: 'Arial',
  1199→    align: 'center',
  1200→  });
  1201→  
  1202→  slide.addText('"There is nothing so important and urgent that it can\'t be done safely"', {
  1203→    x: 1,
  1204→    y: 4.0,
  1205→    w: 8,
  1206→    h: 0.6,
  1207→    fontSize: 22,
  1208→    bold: true,
  1209→    color: 'FF6600',
  1210→    fontFace: 'Arial',
  1211→    align: 'center',
  1212→  });
  1213→  
  1214→  // End text
  1215→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'END' : 'FIM', {
  1216→    x: 4,
  1217→    y: 5.0,
  1218→    w: 2,
  1219→    h: 0.8,
  1220→    fontSize: 28,
  1221→    bold: true,
  1222→    color: 'FF6600',
  1223→    fontFace: 'Arial',
  1224→    align: 'center',
  1225→  });
  1226→  
  1227→  // Report ID reference
  1228→  if (reportId) {
  1229→    slide.addText(`ID: ${reportId}`, {
  1230→      x: 7,
  1231→      y: 6.7,
  1232→      w: 2.7,
  1233→      h: 0.25,
  1234→      fontSize: 7,
  1235→      color: '999999',
  1236→      fontFace: 'Arial',
  1237→      align: 'right',
  1238→    });
  1239→  }
  1240→
  1241→  // Footer
  1242→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? '© 2024 - Services Department | All rights reserved' : '© 2024 - Departamento de Serviços | Todos os direitos reservados', {
  1243→    x: 0.3,
  1244→    y: 7,
  1245→    w: 9.4,
  1246→    h: 0.3,
  1247→    fontSize: 8,
  1248→    color: '666666',
  1249→    fontFace: 'Arial',
  1250→    align: 'center',
  1251→  });
  1252→}

  1346→function formatDateForFileName(dateString: string): string {
  1347→  if (!dateString) return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  1348→  
  1349→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues
  1350→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1351→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1352→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1353→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1354→    const year = parts[0];
  1355→    return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1356→  }
  1357→  
  1358→  // Fallback: use current date
  1359→  const today = new Date();
  1360→  const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  1361→  const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  1362→  const year = today.getFullYear();
  1363→  return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1364→}
  1365→
  1366→function formatDateForDisplay(dateString: string): string {
  1367→  if (!dateString) return '';
  1368→  
  1369→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues (YYYY-MM-DD format)
  1370→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1371→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1372→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1373→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1374→    const year = parts[0];
  1375→    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  1376→  }
  1377→  
  1378→  return dateString;
  1379→}
